definitions.explanation: A room or building where business or administrative work is conducted.

examples.japanese: オフィスで{働|はたら}いています。
{新|あたら}しいオフィスに{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}した。
examples.english: We moved to a new office.

examples.japanese: オフィスビルが{駅前|えきまえ}に{建|た}った。
examples.english: An office building was constructed in front of the station.

notes:
オフィス is a loanword for "office." It is often used for modern, Western-style offices, while {事務所|じむしょ} can refer to any type of office.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- オフィスビル: office building
- オフィス{街|がい}: business district
- ホームオフィス: home office
- オフィスワーク: office work
- オフィスで{働|はたら}く: to work in an office

RELATED WORDS:
- {事務所|じむしょ}: office (more general term)
- {会社|かいしゃ}: company, office
- {職場|しょくば}: workplace

[Register: Neutral]
